pairs: MEL ONE installs timber wall, roof and floor framing to the project drawings. Member sizes, bracing and connections follow the coordinated design, with inspections arranged before the structure is covered.

We install timber wall, roof and floor framing to the project drawings. Member sizes, bracing and connections follow the coordinated design, with inspection responsibilities agreed before the structure is covered.
MEL ONE 按项目图纸安装木墙、屋顶和楼地板框架。构件尺寸、支撑及连接遵循协调后的设计，并在结构封闭前安排检查。
我们按照项目图纸安装木墙架、屋架和楼板框架。构件尺寸、支撑和连接依照协调后的设计施工，并在结构封闭前明确检查责任。

A useful framing quote names the drawing revision, areas or members included and whether the allowance is labour-only or supply and installation. Separate lifting, site access, temporary support, connections to existing work and any removal or reinstatement. These differences can explain why two prices for the same floor plan cover different work.

We price house framing against the issued drawing revision and the areas or members required. Before quoting, we agree whether the package is labour-only or includes timber supply and installation, and discuss lifting, access, temporary support, connections, removal and reinstatement. Inspection and engineering responsibilities are identified separately in the agreed scope.
清晰的框架报价应列明图纸版本、包含区域或构件，以及费用仅含人工还是含供货与安装。吊装、现场通道、临时支撑、与现有结构的连接，以及拆除或复原均应分项说明。这些差异可以解释同一平面图的两份报价为何涵盖不同工作。
我们根据现行图纸版本及所需区域或构件编制木框架报价。报价前，与您商定仅人工还是包供安装，并讨论吊装、出入、临时支撑、连接、拆除和恢复的安排。检查及工程设计责任在商定范围中分别明确。

New outdoor carpentry should suit how you use the yard and how it meets the house. MEL ONE discusses decking and pergola scope, material choices, access and the design responsibilities before work is scheduled.

We plan new timber decks, pergolas and privacy screens around how you use the outdoor space. We review levels, drainage, materials, access and the design responsibilities before pricing the agreed work.
新建户外木作应适合庭院使用方式及其与房屋的衔接。MEL ONE 在排期前讨论木平台和凉棚的施工范围、材料选择、通道及设计责任。
我们根据庭院的实际用途规划新木露台、木廊架和隐私格栅。报价前，我们核对高差、排水、材料、出入条件及设计责任，确定本次施工范围。

Compare each quote against the same layout, materials and supporting work. Identify site preparation, foundations or supports, board or batten quantities, fixings, delivery, removal, surface protection and finishing. A quote for a timber frame should clearly say which coverings and adjoining trades remain separately arranged.

We agree the deck, pergola or screen layout, materials and supporting work with you before quoting. We discuss site preparation, foundations or supports, boards or battens, fixings, delivery, removal, protection and finishing. The written scope distinguishes the agreed timber work from roof coverings and other trade tasks that are separately arranged.
按相同布局、材料和支承施工比较各份报价。明确场地准备、基础或支承、板材或木条数量、固定件、运输、拆除、表面保护和饰面。木框架报价应清楚说明哪些覆盖层及相邻工种仍需另行安排。
报价前，我们与您商定露台、廊架或格栅的布局、材料及支撑工程，并讨论场地准备、基础或支撑、面板或木条、固定件、运输、拆除、保护和涂装。书面范围区分商定的木工与另行安排的屋面覆盖及其他工种。

MEL ONE plans second-fix carpentry around room readiness, floor levels and door schedules. Define the finishing package early so trims, hardware and adjoining trades can meet with fewer unresolved junctions.

We fit internal doors, skirting boards, architraves and agreed timber mouldings for builds and renovations. We check room readiness, finished floor levels and the door schedule so the trim and hardware fit the surrounding finishes.
MEL ONE 根据房间准备状况、地面标高及门表规划后期木工。尽早明确收尾工程包，使装饰线、五金及相邻工种衔接时减少未解决的连接问题。
我们为新建和翻新项目安装室内门、踢脚线、门套线及商定的木饰线。施工前核对房间条件、完成地面标高和门表，让饰线与五金适配周边装修。

Ask the quote to list doors, hardware, profiles, quantities, removal, installation and preparation by room or opening. Separate finishing work, specialist systems and any stair or structural work that needs a different brief. This lets you compare a complete finishing package with a small repair allowance on the same basis.

We agree the doors, hardware, trim profiles and quantities by room or opening before quoting. We discuss removal, installation and preparation, with filling, caulking and painting identified separately. Specialist door systems and structural stair work require their own specified scope; a single damaged trim can be quoted as a local repair.
报价应按房间或洞口列出门、五金、型线、数量、拆除、安装及准备。饰面、专业系统，以及需不同需求说明的楼梯或结构工程应分别列出。这样便于在相同基础上比较完整收尾工程包与小型维修费用。
报价前，我们按房间或门洞与您商定门、五金、饰线板型及数量，讨论拆除、安装和基层准备，填补、打胶及刷漆分别明确。特殊性能门系统和楼梯结构工程须有各自明确的范围；单处饰线损坏也可按局部维修报价。

MEL ONE scopes timber formwork for concrete slabs, beams and walls with the builder and project team. Dimensions, levels, temporary supports and cast-in items determine the forms and erection sequence before the pour.

We scope timber formwork for concrete slabs, beams and walls with the builder and project team. Current drawings, dimensions, levels, temporary supports and cast-in items define the formwork package and erection sequence before the pour.
MEL ONE 与建筑施工方及项目团队确定混凝土楼板、梁和墙的木模板范围。浇筑前，尺寸、标高、临时支撑及预埋件决定模板及搭设顺序。
我们与建筑承包方及项目团队确定混凝土楼板、梁和墙体的木模板范围。浇筑前，依据现行图纸、尺寸、标高、临时支撑和预埋件要求，明确模板项目及搭设顺序。

Identify the elements, dimensions, levels, current drawings, finish requirements and intended staged pours. Specify whether supply, fabrication, erection, stripping or a combination is required, and explain lifting and delivery constraints. These details allow a quote to describe the actual carpentry package instead of relying on a generic area rate.

We price formwork from the issued drawings, dimensions, levels, finish requirements and staged pours. We agree which supply, fabrication, erection and stripping tasks belong in the package, and discuss lifting, delivery and temporary-support responsibilities before quoting. Concrete supply, reinforcement, placement and curing remain separate unless expressly included in the agreed project scope.
明确构件、尺寸、标高、现行图纸、饰面要求及拟议分阶段浇筑。说明需要供应、加工、搭设、拆模还是组合服务，并解释起吊及配送限制。这些细节使报价能描述实际木工工程包，而不是依赖通用面积单价。
我们依据现行图纸、尺寸、标高、表面要求及分段浇筑安排编制模板报价。报价前，与项目方商定包含哪些供料、制作、搭设和拆模工作，并讨论吊装、运输及临时支撑责任。混凝土供应、钢筋、浇筑与养护另列范围，除非商定项目中明确包含。

MEL ONE installs and repairs timber partitions, counters, displays and feature finishes in offices, retail and hospitality spaces. The work sequence accounts for trading hours, deliveries, landlord conditions and access to building services.

We install and repair timber partitions, counters, displays and feature finishes in offices, shops and hospitality premises. We plan the carpentry around trading hours, deliveries, landlord conditions and access to building services.
MEL ONE 在办公室、零售及餐饮空间安装和维修木隔断、柜台、展示构件及特色饰面。施工顺序会考虑营业时间、配送、房东条件及建筑设备检修通道。
我们为办公室、商铺及餐饮接待场所安装和维修木隔断、柜台、展示设施及木饰面。施工安排结合营业时间、送货、业主要求及建筑设备检修通道确定。

Separate the timber elements, finish, removal, protection, transport and installation from other trade packages. Restricted deliveries, occupied-site staging and access equipment can change the allowance even where the final design is the same. Identify who supplies hardware, signage interfaces and any specialist systems.

We agree the commercial timber elements and finishes with the authorised project contact before quoting. We discuss removal, protection, transport, installation, delivery restrictions, occupied-site staging and access equipment. Hardware supply, signage interfaces, specialist systems and other trade responsibilities are identified separately in the agreed scope.
应将木构件、饰面、拆除、防护、运输及安装与其他工种工程包分开。即使最终设计相同，配送限制、使用中场所的分阶段安排及登高作业设备，也可能改变费用。明确五金、标识接口及任何专业系统由谁供应。
报价前，我们与获授权项目联系人商定商业木构件及饰面，讨论拆除、保护、运输、安装、送货限制、营业期间分段安排和登高设备。五金供应、标识衔接、特殊系统及其他工种责任在商定范围中分别明确。

MEL ONE plans and installs kitchen cabinets, vanity joinery and laundry storage around the room, appliances and selected finishes. A measured layout sets the cabinet sizes, door clearances and service openings before manufacture.

We plan and install kitchen cabinets, vanity joinery and laundry storage around your room, appliances and selected finishes. A site measure establishes cabinet sizes, door clearances and service openings before manufacture.
MEL ONE 结合房间、电器及选定饰面规划和安装厨房橱柜、浴室柜木作及洗衣房收纳。实测布局会在制作前确定柜体尺寸、门扇间隙及管线开口。
我们根据房间、家电和选定饰面规划并安装厨房橱柜、浴室柜和洗衣房收纳柜。制作前通过现场测量确定柜体尺寸、柜门活动空间及管线开口。

Compare quotes using the same cabinet quantities, layout, carcass and door materials, edging, hardware and finish. Identify removal, transport, protection, installation, waste and wall or trim making-good. Separately assign benchtops, appliance connections, plumbing, electrical work and wet-area responsibilities so a cabinet price is not read as a complete renovation price.

We agree the cabinetry layout, quantities, materials, edging, hardware and finish with you before quoting. We discuss which removal, transport, protection, installation, waste and wall or trim making-good tasks are included or separately arranged. Benchtops, appliance connections, plumbing, electrical work and wet-area work are identified separately; the written quote records the agreed cabinet scope rather than a complete room renovation.
比较报价时，应使用相同柜体数量、布局、柜身和柜门材料、封边、五金及饰面。明确拆除、运输、防护、安装、废弃物处理，以及墙体或装饰线修复。台面、电器连接、水管、电气及湿区工程应分别指定责任方，避免将柜体价格理解为整体翻新价格。
报价前，我们与您商定橱柜布局、数量、材料、封边、五金及饰面，并讨论拆除、运输、保护、安装、清运及墙面或饰线修补分别包含还是另行安排。台面、家电接驳、水电和湿区工程分别明确；书面报价记录商定的柜作范围，并非整间厨房或浴室翻新。

Architectural joinery brings designed timber details into a room. MEL ONE discusses profiles, finish samples, supports and adjoining surfaces so bespoke features can be scoped before manufacture and installation.

We plan architectural timber features, wall panelling and concealed-door details around the room and agreed design. Profiles, finish samples, supports and adjoining surfaces are reviewed before manufacture and installation are priced.
建筑定制木作将设计中的木材细节融入室内。MEL ONE 会讨论型线、饰面样板、支撑及相邻表面，以便在制作和安装前确定定制构件的施工范围。
我们根据房间条件和商定设计规划特色木作、墙板及隐藏门细节。制作与安装报价前，核对板型、饰面样本、支撑和相邻表面的衔接。

Identify the feature, location, dimensions, profile and intended finish, with any supplied hardware or lighting requirements. Ask the quote to separate preparation, panels or timber components, supports, installation, access equipment and finishing. Kitchen cabinets and fitted storage have their own layout questions and can be linked as distinct packages where part of the same project.

We agree the feature, dimensions, profile and finish with you before quoting, including the specified hardware interfaces. We discuss preparation, panels or timber components, supports, installation, access equipment and finishing as part of that scope. Lighting and electrical work retain their own responsible trades; kitchen cabinets and fitted storage are distinct packages when part of the same project.
明确构件、位置、尺寸、型线及预期饰面，以及任何随附五金或照明要求。报价应分别列出准备、面板或木构件、支撑、安装、登高作业设备及饰面工程。厨房橱柜和嵌入式收纳各有布局问题；同一项目涉及这些内容时，可作为独立施工包衔接。
报价前，我们与您商定特色木作、尺寸、板型及饰面，包括指定五金的衔接要求，并讨论范围中的准备工作、墙板或木构件、支撑、安装、登高设备和涂装。照明与电气工作由相应工种负责；同一项目中的厨房橱柜和定制收纳柜分别界定范围。
MEL ONE plans built-in wardrobes and storage around what needs a place and how the room is used. Review layout, door movement, shelves, finishes and installation access before approving the joinery.

We plan built-in wardrobes, bookcases and study storage around what you need to store and how you use the room. The site measure and agreed layout resolve shelves, door movement, finishes and installation access before manufacture.
MEL ONE 根据需收纳物品和房间用途规划嵌入式衣柜及收纳。批准定制木作前，审查布局、柜门活动、层板、饰面及安装通道。
我们根据收纳物品和房间使用方式规划入墙衣柜、书柜及书房收纳。制作前通过现场测量和布局确认，明确搁板、柜门活动空间、饰面和安装通道。

Compare the same hanging zones, shelves, drawers, door type, materials and hardware across quotes. Identify removal of an existing unit, transport, room protection, installation, waste and adjoining making-good. Lighting, power changes and equipment ventilation remain distinct inclusions or separately arranged work.

We agree the hanging zones, shelves, drawers, doors, materials and hardware before quoting your fitted storage. We discuss whether removal, transport, room protection, installation, waste and adjoining making-good are included or separately arranged. Lighting, power changes and equipment ventilation remain separate scope items, with the agreed work recorded in the written quote.
比较报价时，使用相同挂衣区、层板、抽屉、门型、材料和五金。明确旧柜拆除、运输、房间防护、安装、废料处理和相邻修补。照明、电源变更及设备通风须作为明确的独立包含项，或另行安排。
定制收纳报价前，我们与您商定挂衣区、搁板、抽屉、柜门、材料及五金，并讨论旧柜拆除、运输、房间保护、安装、清运和周边修补分别包含还是另行安排。照明、电源改动和设备通风另列范围，商定的工作记录在书面报价中。

MEL ONE discusses new timber doors and one-off furniture around the setting, dimensions and daily use. Existing sticking doors or damaged windows should first be assessed as repair work before a replacement is specified.

We plan custom timber doors and one-off furniture around the setting, dimensions and daily use. For a sticking door or damaged timber window, we assess the existing repair options before specifying a new item.
MEL ONE 围绕使用环境、尺寸及日常用途讨论新木门和单件定制家具。现有门卡滞或窗户损坏时，应先按维修工程评估，再明确是否更换。
我们根据使用位置、尺寸和日常需求规划定制木门与单件木家具。对于卡顿的门或损坏的木窗，我们先评估现有构件的维修方案，再确定是否需要新制。

A door quote should identify the leaf, frame or retained opening, hardware, glazing responsibilities, removal, installation and making-good. A furniture quote should describe the dimensions, material, construction, finish, delivery and any site fitting. Compare these items on the same specification before choosing between prices.

For a custom door, we agree the leaf, frame or retained opening, hardware, glazing responsibilities, removal, installation and making-good before quoting. For furniture, we discuss dimensions, material, construction, finish, delivery and any site fitting. The written quote records the agreed work, with supply, installation and specialist responsibilities identified for your project.
门类报价应列明门扇、门框或保留洞口、五金、玻璃责任、拆除、安装及恢复修整。家具报价应说明尺寸、材料、结构、饰面、配送及任何现场装配。选择报价前，应在相同规格下比较这些项目。
定制木门报价前，我们与您商定门扇、门框或保留门洞、五金、玻璃责任、拆除、安装及周边修补。家具项目则讨论尺寸、材料、构造、饰面、运输和现场装配。书面报价记录商定工作，并明确本项目的供货、安装及专业工作责任。

MEL ONE assesses accessible timber damage and discusses repair options for Adelaide homes. Trace the water or pest issue, identify sound material and agree any opening-up before defining the carpentry repair.

We assess accessible timber damage and compare local repair, splicing and component replacement. We identify the sound timber to retain and agree any opening-up, with moisture, pest and structural concerns assigned to the appropriate specialists before the affected repair proceeds.
MEL ONE 评估阿德莱德住宅可检查的木材损坏，并讨论维修选项。确定木工维修方案前，应追查水分或虫害问题、识别完好材料，并约定是否揭开检查。
我们检查安全可达的木材损伤，比较局部修补、拼接和构件更换方案。我们确定可保留的完好木材，并与您商定需要拆开检查的部位；相关维修前，先明确潮湿、虫害及结构问题所需的专业评估和责任。

Ask the quote to distinguish retained timber, local repairs, replacement components, fixings and finishing. Separate moisture or pest remedies, structural advice, access equipment, waste and adjoining repairs. This makes it possible to compare two proposed methods without treating a surface treatment as equivalent to a complete timber repair.

We agree which timber to retain, repair or replace, together with fixings and finishing, before quoting. Access equipment, waste and adjoining repairs are part of that discussion, with moisture or pest remedies and structural advice separately assigned. The written scope distinguishes the timber repair from underlying causes that need another trade before the area is closed or finished.
请要求报价区分保留木材、局部维修、替换构件、固定件及饰面。水分或虫害治理、结构建议、作业通达设备（如登高设备）、废料处理及相邻维修应分别列明。这样可比较两种方案，而不会将表面处理视作完整木材维修。
报价前，我们与您商定保留、修复或更换哪些木材，以及固定件和涂装安排，同时讨论登高设备、清运和周边修补。潮湿或虫害处理及结构意见分别明确责任。书面范围区分木材维修与封闭或涂装前需由其他工种处理的成因。

MEL ONE discusses heritage carpentry with retention as the starting point. Record original profiles and condition, then agree the repair approach and any heritage advice or approvals needed for the property.

We assess heritage timber with retention as the starting point, comparing local repair, profile matching and replacement where needed. The agreed approach follows the recorded condition, conservation advice and any approvals required for your property.
MEL ONE 以保留原构件为出发点讨论历史建筑木工。先记录原有型线和状况，再确认维修方法，以及该物业需要的历史建筑保护建议或审批。
我们以保留原有木材为出发点评估历史建筑木作，比较局部维修、板型匹配及必要更换。具体方案依据现状记录、保护意见和该物业所需审批确定。

A useful quote names the elements, retained material, repair or replication decisions, profile references and finishing responsibilities. Include careful removal, access, protection, waste and any agreed investigation stage. Where concealed decay changes the finding, approve the revised scope and price before more original fabric is removed.

We agree which heritage elements and materials to retain, repair or replicate, using the recorded profiles and conservation approach. Before quoting, we discuss finishing, careful removal, access, protection, waste and any investigation stage. If concealed decay changes the repair, we agree the revised scope and price with you before removing more original material.
实用报价应列明构件、保留材料、维修或复制决定、型线参考及饰面责任。包括谨慎拆除、出入、防护、废弃物处理及任何确认的勘查阶段。隐藏腐朽改变评估结果时，应先批准修订范围和价格，再拆除更多原有建筑材料。
我们依据已记录板型及保护方案，与您商定保留、修复或复刻哪些历史构件和材料。报价前讨论涂装、谨慎拆除、出入、保护、清运及分阶段检查。如隐蔽腐朽改变维修范围，我们会在继续移除原材料前，与您商定调整后的工作及价格。
MEL ONE scopes existing deck restoration and indoor timber-floor work as different tasks. Establish timber condition and the cause of wear before choosing repairs, sanding, recoating or replacement.

We repair and refinish existing decks and carry out separately scoped indoor timber-floor work. We check timber condition and the cause of wear before agreeing board repairs, sanding, recoating or replacement.
MEL ONE 将现有户外木平台翻修与室内木地板工程分别界定。在选择维修、打磨、重涂或更换前，先确认木材状况及磨损原因。
我们维修和翻新现有木露台，也承接单独界定范围的室内木地板工程。确定木板维修、打磨、重涂或更换前，先检查木材状况及磨损成因。

Ask for board repair or replacement, fixings, preparation, sanding and coating to be identified separately.
